description: Lives the same people would have been expected to survive had they been belted/helmeted, using the within-vehicle (double pair comparison) effectiveness from the matched module applied to all seat positions; the belt estimate is sensitive to survivors' belt use being misrecorded (misreport scenarios)
method: Census counts; alcohol quantities are means over NHTSA's 10 BAC implicates with MI SE sqrt(1.1 * between-implicate variance)
